def calculate_content_hash(content):
    normalized = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', content.strip().lower())
    return hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def estimate_tokens(text):
    return int(len(text.split()) * 1.33)


def extract_metadata(soup, url):
    metadata = {
        "title": "",
        "language": "hungarian",
        "category": "",
        "framework": "",
        "description": ""
    }
    title_tag = soup.find("h1") or soup.find("title")
    if title_tag:
        metadata["title"] = title_tag.get_text(strip=True)
    meta_tags = soup.find_all("meta")
    for meta in meta_tags:
        if meta.get("name") == "description":
            metadata["description"] = meta.get("content", "")
        if meta.get("property") == "og:title":
            metadata["title"] = meta.get("content", metadata["title"])
    path_parts = urlparse(url).path.split("/")
    if len(path_parts) > 1:
        metadata["framework"] = path_parts[1]
    return metadata


def advanced_content_cleaning(html_text):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html_text, "html.parser")
    for tag in soup(["script", "style", "noscript", "iframe", "nav", "header", "footer", "aside", "form", "button"]):
        tag.decompose()
    for tag in soup.find_all(class_=re.compile(r"(advertisement|ad-|cookie|banner|popup|modal|sidebar|comment)")):
        tag.decompose()
    for tag in soup.find_all(id=re.compile(r"(advertisement|ad-|cookie|banner|popup|modal)")):
        tag.decompose()
    text_content = soup.get_text(separator="\n", strip=True)
    lines = [line.strip() for line in text_content.split("\n") if line.strip()]
    cleaned_text = "\n".join(lines)
    return cleaned_text

def quality_check_content(content):
    if not content or len(content.strip()) < 300:
        return False
    quality_score = 0
    code_blocks = len(re.findall(r'```', content))
    if code_blocks > 0:
        quality_score += min(code_blocks * 3, 15)
    headers = len(re.findall(r'^#{1,6}\s+.+$', content, re.MULTILINE))
    if headers >= 3:
        quality_score += min(headers * 2, 10)
    hungarian_words = len(re.findall(r'\b[a-záéíóöőúüű]{4,}\b', content, re.IGNORECASE))
    if hungarian_words > 100:
        quality_score += 10
    technical_terms = len(re.findall(
        r'\b(function|class|method|API|interface|parameter|return|example|használat|alkalmazás|példa|függvény|metódus|osztály)\b',
        content,
        re.IGNORECASE
    ))
    if technical_terms > 10:
        quality_score += min(technical_terms, 15)
    tables = len(re.findall(r'\|.+\|', content))
    if tables > 0:
        quality_score += min(tables, 10)
    lists = len(re.findall(r'^[\*\-\+]\s+.+$', content, re.MULTILINE))
    if lists > 5:
        quality_score += min(lists, 10)
    word_count = len(content.split())
    if word_count > 200:
        quality_score += 10
    line_count = len(content.split("\n"))
    avg_line_length = word_count / max(line_count, 1)
    if 5 < avg_line_length < 30:
        quality_score += 5
    noise_indicators = len(re.findall(r'(cookie|advertisement|subscribe|newsletter|spam|click here)', content, re.IGNORECASE))
    quality_score -= noise_indicators * 5
    return quality_score >= 40

def get_all_links(url, base_domain):
    try:
        response = requests.get(
            url,
            timeout=15,
            headers={
                "User-Agent": (
                    "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) "
                    "AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) "
                    "Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
                )
            }
        )
        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")
        links = set()
        pdf_links = set()
        for link in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
            href = link.get("href")
            full_url = urljoin(url, href)
            parsed = urlparse(full_url)
            if parsed.netloc == base_domain and not parsed.fragment:
                clean_url = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}{parsed.path}"
                if parsed.query:
                    clean_url += f"?{parsed.query}"
                if clean_url.endswith(".pdf"):
                    pdf_links.add(clean_url)
                else:
                    links.add(clean_url)
        return links, pdf_links
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error getting links from {url}: {str(e)[:80]}")
        return set(), set()

def worker_thread(url_queue, pdf_queue, base_domain, max_pages):
    while True:
        try:
            url = url_queue.get(timeout=10)
            with url_lock:
                if len(visited_urls) >= max_pages:
                    url_queue.task_done()
                    break
            crawl_page(url, base_domain)
            new_links, new_pdfs = get_all_links(url, base_domain)
            for link in new_links:
                with url_lock:
                    if link not in visited_urls and len(visited_urls) < max_pages:
                        url_queue.put(link)
            for pdf_link in new_pdfs:
                with pdf_lock:
                    if pdf_link not in visited_pdfs:
                        pdf_queue.put(pdf_link)
            url_queue.task_done()
        except queue.Empty:
            break
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Worker error: {str(e)[:100]}")
            try:
                url_queue.task_done()
            except Exception:
                pass

    url_threads = []
    num_url_workers = len(api_keys) * 20
    for i in range(num_url_workers):
        t = threading.Thread(target=worker_thread, args=(url_queue, pdf_queue, base_domain, max_pages), daemon=True)
        t.start()
        url_threads.append(t)
    pdf_threads = []
    num_pdf_workers = len(api_keys) * 15
    for i in range(num_pdf_workers):
        t = threading.Thread(target=pdf_worker_thread, args=(pdf_queue,), daemon=True)

        pdf_threads.append(t)
    url_queue.join()
    for t in url_threads:
        t.join(timeout=5)
    time.sleep(10)
    pdf_queue.join()
    for t in pdf_threads:
        t.join(timeout=5)
    return visited_urls

def quality_check_content(content):
    if not content or len(content.strip()) < 300:
        return False
    quality_score = 0
    code_blocks = len(re.findall(r'```', content))
    if code_blocks > 0:
        quality_score += min(code_blocks * 3, 15)
    headers = len(re.findall(r'^#{1,6}\s+.+$', content, re.MULTILINE))
    if headers >= 3:
        quality_score += min(headers * 2, 10)
    hungarian_words = len(re.findall(r'\b[a-záéíóöőúüű]{4,}\b', content, re.IGNORECASE))
    if hungarian_words > 100:
        quality_score += 10
    technical_terms = len(re.findall(
        r'\b(function|class|method|API|interface|parameter|return|example|használat|alkalmazás|példa|függvény|metódus|osztály)\b',
        content,
        re.IGNORECASE
    ))
    if technical_terms > 10:
        quality_score += min(technical_terms, 15)
    tables = len(re.findall(r'\|.+\|', content))
    if tables > 0:
        quality_score += min(tables, 10)
    lists = len(re.findall(r'^[\*\-\+]\s+.+$', content, re.MULTILINE))
    if lists > 5:
        quality_score += min(lists, 10)
    word_count = len(content.split())
    if word_count > 200:
        quality_score += 10
    line_count = len(content.split("\n"))
    avg_line_length = word_count / max(line_count, 1)
    if 5 < avg_line_length < 30:
        quality_score += 5
    noise_indicators = len(re.findall(r'(cookie|advertisement|subscribe|newsletter|spam|click here)', content, re.IGNORECASE))
    quality_score -= noise_indicators * 5
    return quality_score >= 40

### 1. Agresszívebb, struktúra‑alapú HTML tisztítás

def advanced_content_cleaning(html_text):

        or soup.select_one(".content")

        tag.decompose()

    noisy_phrases = [
        "Edit on GitHub",
        "Table of contents",
        "DevDocs",  # ha nagyon sokszor ismétlődik
        "©",        # jogi láblábak

    lines = [line.strip() for line in text_content.split("\n") if line.strip()]

def is_probably_hungarian(text: str) -> bool:

A jelenlegi quality‑score jó kezdet, de a modern LLM‑pipeline‑ek sokkal agresszívebben dedupláznak, szűrik a zajt, és mérik a struktúra‑minőséget. [attached_file:1][web:3]

def quality_check_content(content: str) -> bool:
    if not content:
        return False

    text = content.strip()
    if len(text) < 500:
        return False  # túl rövid

    quality_score = 0

    # 1) Struktúra: kódblokkok, fejlécek, listák, táblák
    code_blocks = len(re.findall(r"```", text))
    headers = len(re.findall(r"^#{1,6}\s+.+$", text, re.MULTILINE))
    lists = len(re.findall(r"^[\*\-\+]\s+.+$", text, re.MULTILINE))
    tables = len(re.findall(r"\|.+\|", text))

    if code_blocks >= 1:
        quality_score += min(code_blocks * 2, 10)
    if headers >= 3:
        quality_score += min(headers * 2, 10)
    if lists >= 5:
        quality_score += min(lists, 8)
    if tables >= 1:
        quality_score += min(tables * 2, 8)

    # 2) Technikai „jelzőszavak”
    technical_terms = re.findall(
        r"\b(function|class|method|api|interface|parameter|return|request|response|függvény|osztály|metódus|visszatérési érték|példa|használat)\b",
        text, re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    if len(technical_terms) > 20:
        quality_score += 15
    elif len(technical_terms) > 10:
        quality_score += 10
    elif len(technical_terms) > 5:
        quality_score += 5

    # 3) Nyelvi minőség: szavak száma, átlag sorhossz
    words = text.split()
    word_count = len(words)
    line_count = len(text.split("\n"))
    avg_line_length = word_count / max(line_count, 1)

    if word_count > 300:
        quality_score += 10
    if 6 < avg_line_length < 35:
        quality_score += 5

    # 4) Zaj / spam / boilerplate büntetés
    noise_patterns = r"(cookie|advertisement|subscribe|newsletter|click here|privacy policy|terms of use)"
    noise_hits = len(re.findall(noise_patterns, text, re.IGNORECASE))
    quality_score -= noise_hits * 5

    # 5) Túl sok nem-alfanumerikus jel (pl. logok, minified kód)
    non_alnum = len(re.findall(r"[^A-Za-z0-9ÁÉÍÓÖŐÚÜŰáéíóöőúüű\s]", text))
    if non_alnum / max(len(text), 1) > 0.25:
        quality_score -= 10

    # 6) Nyelv-check
    if not is_probably_hungarian(text):
        return False

    return quality_score >= 40
```

                    break

                with url_lock:
                    if link not in visited_urls and len(visited_urls) < max_pages:

            for pdf_link in new_pdfs:
                with pdf_lock:
                    if pdf_link not in visited_pdfs:
                        pdf_queue.put(pdf_link)
            url_queue.task_done()
        except queue.Empty:
            break

            print(f"Worker error: {str(e)[:100]}")

                url_queue.task_done()

                pass
